Diagnosis: The parser failed because the same stage included both manipulator_low_effort and manipulator_high_effort on the directional_rotate term. The runtime explicitly requires exactly one manipulator effort condition per atomic action, so the smallest repair is to remove manipulator_low_effort and keep manipulator_high_effort as the representable safety stop for excessive effort or hard contact.
Reasoning: The stage remains one conjunctive controller stage. freeze_position keeps the panda_fingertip origin fixed within 0.01 m. object_grasped maintains the already closed, firm grasp without also emitting close_gripper. directional_rotate commands the grasped estop_cap_center to rotate about its own +z axis in the positive unlock sense, with the 45 degree maximum angular travel encoded as 0.7853981634 rad. The directional_rotate condition keeps geometry for the unlock rotation/pose stop and manipulator_high_effort for the representable early safety stop on excessive effort or unintended hard contact. The low-effort/detent-settling stop cue cannot be included together with manipulator_high_effort because the runtime rejects conflicting manipulator effort conditions in a single atomic stage.
